title: Traceability, evidence, and separate review
statement: Every X-Verse capability must provide bidirectional traceability from system requirement through feature software requirement, component, unit, code, and test to exact-run evidence, with a separate review and explicit acceptance.
applicability: X-Verse capability 007 governance; T020 provides the candidate trace/evidence records.
verification_intent: Realized for the T020 slice by T020-SR-006 and T020-SR-007; external acceptance remains a separate deferred gate.
acceptance_criteria: A complete system-to-test matrix exists for every accepted requirement.
Review, acceptance, and integration are recorded as separate gates, not claimed by this candidate.
